title: What Makes Geeks Tick? A Study of Stack Overflow Careers
authors: Lei Xu; Tingting Nian; Luis Cabral
eligible_reason: Table 2 (Reg_JDD.do, the only regressions shipped) is a within-user triple difference: unit SO_VGA = user x activity type (VGA = 1 answers/votes, 0 edits), monthly, window -4..+3 months around each user's job change (JC_Date). xtreg A_E S S_VGA, i(SO_VGA) fe: S = new job (switches on at user-specific dates for both activity units of the user) and S_VGA = S x answer activity is the coefficient of interest. S is an additional staggered treatment regressor on the comparison (edits) units, i.e. a DDD with an extra staggered regressor (5b ruling, as the within-hotel platform DDD). Column 1 has no calendar-time FE; column 2 adds activity-specific year, month-of-year and SO-tenure (AgeSO_VGA) dummies, the last an extra additive FE on a non-calendar dimension. In the shipped data 1,297 of 1,301 users change jobs (essentially no never-treated units). Not an eligible design.
design_notes: Stata xtreg fe robust. Data_JDD.dta: 18,192 rows, 1,301 users x 2 activity types, Date in months (109-182), JC_Date job-change month (staggered 109-179), S = (Date >= JC_Date) exactly. Outcomes A_E (log answers or edits), V_E (log votes or edits). Do file loads Main_JDD.dta (shipped as Data_JDD.dta); Main_JDD_X.dta for column 2 not shipped. 71 distinct job-change months; 191 users have 2-4 job-change episodes (JC_Date varies within user), so the panel is a set of per-episode event windows rather than a single adoption per unit.
data_files_note: Summarized Stack Overflow activity around job changes for Table 2 column 1/3 shipped; Data_JDD_X.dta (controls version) withheld for size; raw Stack Overflow Careers CV data not included.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Staggered job changes, but the estimand is a within-user answers-vs-edits DDD with the new-job main effect as an extra staggered regressor; no calendar-time FE in the baseline column.
